programme.title: Guys and Dolls
programme.desc: In New York, a gambler is challenged to take a cold female missionary to Havana, but they fall for each other, and the bet has a hidden motive to finance a crap game.

programme.title: Flower Drum Song
programme.desc: A young woman arrives in San Francisco's Chinatown from Hong Kong with the intention of marrying a rakish nightclub owner, unaware he is involved with one of his singers.

programme.title: South Pacific
programme.desc: On a South Pacific island during World War II, love blooms between a young nurse and a secretive Frenchman who's being courted for a dangerous military mission.

programme.title: Father Goose
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars in one of his funniest roles as a boozy beachcomber sitting out WWII in peace - until the Allies recruit him to be a lookout on the South Pacific isle.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia
programme.desc: When a family moves from the city to a centuries-old house in rural Georgia, they are terrorized by malicious spirits seeking revenge.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

programme.title: Losing Isaiah
programme.desc: Jessica Lange plays an adoptive mother who gives an abandoned child a new chance at life. Halle Berry is the birth mother who cleans up her life and sets out to reclaim the child.

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: With showstopping performances by a star-studded cast, Dreamgirls soars with the amazing story of three female singers who learn that anything is possible when you hold on to your dreams.

programme.title: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Wing Chun, a talented martial artist, decides to fight against horse thieves in the village to receive respect from the villagers.

programme.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
programme.desc: When an interdimensional rupture unravels reality, an unlikely hero (Michelle Yeoh) must channel her newfound powers to fight bizarre and bewildering dangers from the multiverse as the fate of everything hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Chocolate
programme.desc: A young girl learns to fight from watching TV and the fighters at the boxing school next door. She sets upon a violent quest to collect payment for her ailing mother's medical expenses which ultimately leads her to her father, a member of the Yakuza.

programme.title: Drugstore June
programme.desc: After the pharmacy in her small town is robbed, a girl who still lives at home with her parents takes matters into her own hands to solve the crime, while at the same time trying to get over her ex-boyfriend and become more of an adult.

programme.title: Mean Girls

programme.title: Mean Girls 2
programme.desc: The Plastics are back in the follow-up to the smash-hit Mean Girls... and now the clique is more fashionable, funny and ferocious than ever!

programme.title: Grease

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Flashdance

programme.title: Apocalypto

programme.title: Nightcrawler
programme.desc: A freelance cameraman (Jake Gyllenhaal) goes to increasingly greater lengths to get shots of the most-lurid and disturbing crimes on the dark streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Braveheart

programme.title: The Fantasticks

programme.title: Father Goose
programme.desc: Cary Grant stars in one of his funniest roles as a boozy beachcomber sitting out WWII in peace - until the Allies recruit him to be a lookout on the South Pacific isle.

programme.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
programme.desc: Spencer Tracy leads a hilariously zany cast of Hollywood's greatest comedians (including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman and Mickey Rooney) as eight vacation-bound motorists set off on a mad-cap, side-splitting race to find a stolen fortune!

programme.title: Artists and Models
programme.desc: A goonish young man receives telepathic top secret information in his nightmares, which are used by his artist friend in comic strips. Foreign agents and the CIA get interested.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: Tom Cruise is superb as Maverick Mitchell, a young flyer who's out to become the best. And Kelly McGillis plays the instructor who teaches Maverick a few things you can't learn in a classroom.

programme.title: Top Gun: Maverick
programme.desc: Pete "Maverick" Mitchell keeps pushing the envelope after years of service as one of the Navy's top aviators. He must soon confront the past while training a new squad of graduates for a dangerous mission that demands the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: The Messengers (2007)
programme.desc: An ominous darkness invades a seemingly serene sunflower farm in North Dakota, and the Solomon family is torn apart by suspicion, mayhem and murder.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: Amistad
programme.desc: AMISTAD is about a 1839 mutiny onboard a slave ship that is traveling towards the Northeast Coast of America. Much of the story involves a court-room drama about the slave who led the revolt.

programme.title: Drumline
programme.desc: A drummer helps his Atlanta College marching band defeat a rival in a Southern battle-of-the-bands.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: Raging Phoenix
programme.desc: A violent Thai gang is abducting and killing women around Thailand. Sanim and his friends, having had loved ones abducted, have joined together to break up the gang of kidnappers. In a botched kidnap attempt, Deu (JeeJa Yanin) is saved by Sanim's crew.

programme.title: Clash
programme.desc: Trinh, a mercenary, must complete a series of organized crime jobs for her boss in order to win the release of her kidnapped daughter.

programme.title: Furie
programme.desc: When a little girl is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, they soon find they messed with the wrong child. Her mother, a notorious former gang leader, is close on their trail and will go to any lengths to bring her daughter home.

programme.title: Like a Boss
programme.desc: Best friends, Mia and Mel (Tiffany Haddish & Rose Byrne), are running their own cosmetics company when a villainous beauty mogul (Salma Hayek) conspires to steal it. Mia and Mel must stick together and fight to reclaim their company.

programme.title: 50 First Dates
programme.desc: A playboy tries to win over the girl of his dreams when he discovers she has no short-term memory.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Steel Magnolias
programme.desc: Six divas of the silver screen - Sally Field, Dolly Parton, Shirley MacLaine, Daryl Hannah, Olympia Dukakis and Julia Roberts - come together as bosom buddies in this hilarious and heartwarming story of life, love and loss in a small Louisiana parish.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Source Code
programme.desc: Jake Gyllenhaal stars in this action thriller about a man who awakens in another man’s body to discover only he has the ability to stop a terrorist attack on a commuter train.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Big Fish
programme.desc: Throughout his life, Edward Bloom (Ewan McGregor) has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: True Grit (2010)
programme.desc: True Grit is a powerful story of vengeance and valor set in an unforgiving and unpredictable frontier where justice is simple and mercy is rare.

programme.title: Geronimo: An American Legend
programme.desc: An American legend comes to life in this epic Western starring Jason Patric, Robert Duvall, Gene Hackman and Wes Studi as Geronimo, giving a stunning performance as the fearless warrior who was the last Indian leader to surrender to the white man.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Angels & Demons
programme.desc: Expert symbologist Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows ancient clues on a heart-racing hunt through Rome to find the four Cardinals kidnapped by the deadly secret society, the Illuminati.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows a trail of clues across Europe with Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) to stop a virus that would wipe out half the world’s population.

programme.title: High Life
programme.desc: Monte (Robert Pattinson) and his baby daughter are the last survivors of a damned and dangerous mission to the outer reaches of the solar system. They rely on each other to survive as they hurtle toward the oblivion of a black hole.

programme.title: The Witch
programme.desc: In 1630 New England, panic and despair envelops a farmer, his wife and their children when youngest son Samuel suddenly vanishes.

programme.title: Under the Skin
programme.desc: A voluptuous woman of unknown origin (Scarlett Johansson) combs the highways in search of isolated men, luring a series of lost souls into an otherworldly lair. From visionary director Jonathan Glazer comes a masterpiece of science fiction.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: Woodshock
programme.desc: A haunted young woman spirals into confusion and chaos after she falls under the spell of a potent reality-altering drug.

programme.title: Deliver Us from Evil (2014)
programme.desc: A NYPD officer (Eric Bana) and unconventional priest Mendoza (Edgar Ramírez) who join forces to investigate a series of disturbing & inexplicable crimes. Together, they must combat the possessions that are terrorizing their city before it's too late.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Next of Kin
programme.desc: When policeman Truman Gates' younger brother is murdered by the mob, Gates is torn between his desire to uphold the law and his lust for revenge. But Gates' older brother will not be satisfied until every member of the Chicago mob is dead.

programme.title: Black Rain
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Michael Douglas and Andy Garcia play New York cops whose job to escort an assassin back to his native Japan leads the two Americans into Osaka's underworld and straight into the center of a raging battle.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Ghost Protocol
programme.desc: Agent Ethan Hunt and his elite team go underground after a bombing implicates them as terrorists. While trying to clear their name, the team uncovers a plot to start a nuclear war.

programme.title: Mission: Impossible - Rogue Nation
programme.desc: Ethan and team take on their most impossible mission yet, eradicating the Syndicate - an International rogue organization as highly skilled as they are, committed to destroying the IMF.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: The Godfather Part II
programme.desc: The continuing saga of a young Vito Corleone growing up in Sicily and in New York during the 1910s and then following Michael Corleone in the 1950s as he tries to expand the family business.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: A chilling portrait of the Corleone family's rise and near fall from power in America along with balancing the story of the Sicilian clan's ugly crime business in which they are engaged.

programme.title: Pain & Gain
programme.desc: When an ambitious group of personal trainers go after the American Dream, they get caught up in a criminal enterprise that goes horribly wrong. Now, living large will take everything they've got in this unbelievable and outrageous true story.

programme.title: Spotlight
programme.desc: This critically acclaimed film chronicles the true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered a decades-long cover-up of child abuse within the local Catholic Archdiocese.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Based on the true story of four outsiders who saw what the big banks, media, and government refused to: the global collapse of the economy. A bold investment leads them into the dark underbelly of banking, where everyone and everything is in question.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: While You Were Sleeping
programme.desc: Lucy becomes smitten with a handsome stranger.

programme.title: Escape from Alcatraz
programme.desc: Superstar Clint Eastwood and director Don Siegel re-team for their fifth film in this fascinating account of the only three men ever to escape from the infamous maximum security prison at Alcatraz.

programme.title: Death Wish
programme.desc: In this explosive story of revenge and urban violence, Charles Bronson plays Paul Kersey, a bleeding-heart liberal who has a change of opinion after his wife and daughter are violently attacked by a gang of thugs in their apartment.

programme.title: Joe (1970)
programme.desc: Anti-hippie Joe (Peter Boyle) finds a kindred spirit in Bill Compton (Dennis Patrick) who boasts that he killed a drug-dealing hippie (Patrick McDermott). When a news report confirms the incident, vigilante justice is set in motion.

programme.title: Gravity
programme.desc: On a seemingly routine spacewalk, disaster strikes, leaving two astronauts completely alone. As the deafening silence tells them they have lost any link to Earth, the only way home may be to go further into the terrifying expanse of space.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: A wrongly-convicted man must try to survive a public execution gauntlet staged as a TV game show.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D. and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earths closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Premonition
programme.desc: Linda Hanson (Sandra Bullock) has a beautiful house, a loving husband and two adorable daughters. Her life is perfect, until the day she gets the devastating news that her husband Jim (Julian McMahon) has died in a car accident. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)

programme.title: It's a Mad, Mad, Mad, Mad World
programme.desc: Spencer Tracy leads a hilariously zany cast of Hollywood's greatest comedians (including Milton Berle, Sid Caesar, Ethel Merman and Mickey Rooney) as eight vacation-bound motorists set off on a mad-cap, side-splitting race to find a stolen fortune!

programme.title: Artists and Models
programme.desc: A goonish young man receives telepathic top secret information in his nightmares, which are used by his artist friend in comic strips. Foreign agents and the CIA get interested.

programme.title: Frank Capra's A Hole In The Head
programme.desc: Frank Capra catches lightning in bottle again when he teams with Frank Sinatra and Eleanor Parker in this heartwarming comedy about the problems of a footloose widower, his 12-year-old son, a bongo-playing showgirl and a matchmaking sister-in-law.

programme.title: Blithe Spirit
programme.desc: A man and his second wife are haunted by the ghost of his first wife.

programme.title: Jack Reacher
programme.desc: Investigator Jack Reacher leaps off the pages of Lee Child's novel and onto the big screen in this thriller. When a horrible crime is committed, all evidence points to the suspect in custody, who offers up a single note in defense: "Get Jack Reacher!"

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: The Eye
programme.desc: A blind girl receives a cornea transplant so that she is able to see again. However, she gets more than she bargains for when she realizes she can see disturbing ghosts.

programme.title: Mother's Day (2012)
programme.desc: Rebecca DeMornay is terrifying in this brutal gorefest. When her sons break into a home and take the owners hostage, she teaches them what real torture is all about. Costars Shawn Ashmore.

programme.title: The Babadook
programme.desc: In this terrifying thriller, a mother must protect her son from an evil, supernatural entity that has escaped the pages of a children's book and is lurking in their home.

programme.title: The Fighting Temptations
programme.desc: To collect his aunt's inheritance, an unemployed man (Cuba Gooding Jr.) must form a gospel choir and lead it to success.

programme.title: Barbershop
programme.desc: Calvin, who inherited a struggling barbershop, views the shop as nothing but a burden and a waste of his time. After selling the shop to a local loan shark, Calvin slowly begins to see his father's vision and legacy.

programme.title: Barbershop 2: Back in Business
programme.desc: The Barbershop is threatened by the arrival of a hip, well-financed chain barbershop that's about to open next door.

programme.title: Furie
programme.desc: When a little girl is kidnapped by a trafficking ring, they soon find they messed with the wrong child. Her mother, a notorious former gang leader, is close on their trail and will go to any lengths to bring her daughter home.

programme.title: No Mercy
programme.desc: In this vengeance-fueled thriller, a martial arts champion will stop at nothing to find her missing younger sister --hunting down the predators that kidnapped and assaulted her one by one.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Bloody revenge is at the heart of this stylish action-thriller that doses the classic femme fatale story with a shot of adrenaline as it follows a former assassin who will stop at nothing to cut ties to her past.

programme.title: Mean Girls
programme.desc: Cady thinks she understands "survival of the fittest." However, the law of the wild takes a whole new meaning when the homeschooled 15-year-old enters public high school for the first time.

programme.title: Mean Girls 2
programme.desc: The Plastics are back in the follow-up to the smash-hit Mean Girls... and now the clique is more fashionable, funny and ferocious than ever!

programme.title: Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Max and Page are a mother/daughter con team. Max targets wealthy men and marries them. Page then seduces them while Max "catches" her wayward husbands in the act. Then on to the next mark, posing in a variety of guises to keep one step ahead of the law.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: About Last Night (1986)
programme.desc: Rob Lowe doesn't want to get serious. Demi Moore doesn't want to get used. Together, they're an unforgettable couple in the sexy, contemporary comedy, ABOUT LAST NIGHT. Rating: R

programme.title: Flashdance
programme.desc: The visual and musical box-office smash Flashdance is the exhilarating story of Alex Owens (Jennifer Beals), a fiercely determined and beautiful 18-year-old woman, who works as a welder by day and a dancer at a local bar at night.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: The Marksman
programme.desc: A hardened Arizona rancher tries to protect an 11-year-old migrant boy fleeing from a ruthless drug cartel.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: The People vs. Larry Flynt
programme.desc: Two-time Oscar winner Milos Forman directs Woody Harrelson and Courtney Love in this acclaimed film about "Hustler" publisher Larry Flynt. Rating: R

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: A self-assured American sharpshooter moves to Australia in search of employment and finds work for a despotic land baron in the Australian outback.

programme.title: Posse
programme.desc: There's action galore in this off-beat western that features a group of mostly black infantrymen who return from the Spanish-American War with a cache of gold. The men travel to the West where their leader searches for the men who lynched his father.

programme.title: Heaven's Gate
programme.desc: This ambitious frontier epic features a lawman (Kris Kristofferson) and a hitman (Christopher Walken) who fight in a tragic class war between ranchers and starving immigrants.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Robert Langdon (Tom Hanks) follows a trail of clues across Europe with Sienna Brooks (Felicity Jones) to stop a virus that would wipe out half the world’s population.

programme.title: A Few Good Men
programme.desc: Tom Cruise stars as a brash Navy lawyer who's teamed with a gung-ho litigator (Demi Moore) in a politically explosive murder case, defending two Marines accused of killing a fellow soldier

programme.title: School of Rock

programme.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programme.desc: A young Englishwoman goes to the Hebrides to marry her older, wealthier fiancé. When the weather keeps them separated on different islands, she begins to have second thoughts.

programme.title: The Killing
programme.desc: With fascinating detail, Stanley Kubrick lays bare the intricate inner-planning of a racetrack heist by a deadly mastermind (Sterling Hayden) and his crew. Co-stars Coleen Gray.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: This powerful, fact-based absurdity-of-war film stars Kirk Douglas as a commanding officer who defends three scapegoats on trial for a failed offensive that occurred within the French Army in 1916.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Death Warrant
programme.desc: Action superstar Jean-Claude van Damme ("Bloodsport", "Cyborg") is a veteran undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt state prison.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: What Lies Beneath
programme.desc: The wife of a professor investigates the murder of a beautiful college student who has been appearing to her.

programme.title: The Haunting In Connecticut
programme.desc: After a family is forced to relocate for their son's health, they begin experiencing supernatural behavior in their new home, which turns out to be a former mortuary and séance parlor.

programme.title: The Haunting in Connecticut 2: Ghosts of Georgia
programme.desc: When a family moves from the city to a centuries-old house in rural Georgia, they are terrorized by malicious spirits seeking revenge.

programme.title: Beauty Shop (2005)
programme.desc: Gina is a long way from the Barbershop - she's moved from Chicago to Atlanta and buys a rundown salon and inherits a motley group of stylists and a colorful clientele. It's a rocky road to fulfilling her dreams, but you can't keep a good woman down!

programme.title: Barbershop: The Next Cut
programme.desc: It's been more than 10 years since our last appointment at Calvin's Barbershop. Ice Cube, Cedric the Entertainer and the whole crew are back together for a quick trim, some good conversation, a little gossip...and to save their neighborhood!

programme.title: Breakin' All the Rules
programme.desc: Inspired by his fiancée (who dumped him), a man publishes a break-up hand-book for men, becoming a best-selling author in the process.

programme.title: Memories of the Sword
programme.desc: While in medieval Korea, a young girl sets out to revenge the betrayal and the death of her mother. But therefore she must face one of the most powerful men and warriors of the Goryo Dynasty.

programme.title: Rampant
programme.desc: Returning from imprisonment abroad, a prince and his fellow countrymen band together to battle bloodthirsty demons in ancient Korea.

programme.title: The Swordsman
programme.desc: After being blinded in a coup against the king, Joseon’s greatest swordsman goes into hiding, far removed from his city’s anguish. But when traffickers kidnap his daughter, he has no choice but to unsheathe his sword once more.

programme.title: Hook
programme.desc: Superstars Robin Williams, Dustin Hoffman and Julia Roberts star in award-winning director Steve Spielberg's updating of PETER PAN.

programme.title: Superstar
programme.desc: All Mary Katherine Gallagher wants in life is a kiss. Not just any kiss, mind you – a Hollywood-style kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, no one will kiss her. She decides that to get her kiss, she must become just like the people in the movies.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: Grease
programme.desc: Grease is the one that you want! Go back to high school with Pink Lady Sandy (Olivia Newton-John), leader of the bad-boy T-Birds, Danny (John Travolta), and a rockin' and rollin' all-star cast.

programme.title: Grease 2
programme.desc: Return to rockin’ Rydell High for a whole new term! It’s 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there’s a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

programme.title: Strictly Ballroom
programme.desc: A championship ballroom dancer finds inspiration within, and decides he'll stop at nothing to win, even if it means rewriting the rules. A worldwide feel-good hit, with an incredible soundtrack, from director Baz Luhrmann (MOULIN ROUGE!).

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Night Hunter
programme.desc: The hunt is on as a detective races against time to stay one step ahead of an arrested serial killer masterminding deadly attacks from behind bars. Henry Cavill and Ben Kingsley star in this action-packed thriller that will shock you at every turn.

programme.title: The Pianist
programme.desc: BEST PICTURE WINNER & 7-TIME OSCAR NOMINEE, THE PIANIST is director Roman Polanski’s most personal movie ever, and stars Oscar winner Adrien Brody in the true-life story of brilliant pianist, Wladyslaw Szpilman.

programme.title: Forrest Gump
programme.desc: Tom Hanks gives an astonishing performance as Forrest, an everyman whose simple innocence comes to embody a generation.

programme.title: There Will Be Blood
programme.desc: A sprawling epic about family, faith, power and oil. The story chronicles the life of Daniel Plainview, who transforms himself from a down-and-out silver miner into a self-made oil tycoon.

programme.title: The Conspirator
programme.desc: From director Robert Redford comes the riveting true story behind the assassination trial of Abraham Lincoln – including the lone woman who was accused of plotting his murder.

programme.title: End of the Rope
programme.desc: Based on a true story. Sheriff Jacobson and Attorney Taylor investigate the disappearance of the Haven Family while facing a town bent on vengeance against suspect Charles Bannon.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
programme.desc: There's nothing more exciting than trying to keep up with the Joneses in Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade. Indy's Nazi enemies are back and have kidnapped his father, in their effort to locate the sacred Holy Grail.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS bring you the greatest adventurer of all time! Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull finds Indy trying to outrace a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator.

programme.title: The Phantom
programme.desc: The story begins as an expedition lands on the island of Bengalla, seeking the Skulls of Touganda. Believed to harness an energy force of power, they could spell disaster for mankind.

programme.title: School of Rock
programme.desc: Jack Black stars as a guitarist with delusions of grandeur. Kicked out of his band and looking for work, he becomes a substitute teacher and turns his class into rock and rollers.

programme.title: Trapped
programme.desc: The Jennings fight for their daughter's life after she is kidnapped by an experienced gang of thieves.

programme.title: Hollywood Homicide
programme.desc: A pair of detectives investigate a murder while pursuing their other full-time professions. Welcome to Hollywood Homicide - the only place where you can come to work hungry, horny, thirsty, and broke, and resolve all four by the end of the watch.

programme.title: Sleepless in Seattle
programme.desc: Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan star in an enchanting romance about a widower whose son convinces him to find new love and the woman who answers his call.

programme.title: The Road
programme.desc: In the years following a world-shattering apocalyptic event, a father and son travel on foot through the charred remains of North America, struggling to survive on a quest to reach the ocean.

programme.title: Surfer, Dude
programme.desc: Longboarding soul surfer Steve Addington (Matthew McConaughey) returns to Malibu for the summer to find his cool hometown vibe corrupted.

programme.title: Bad Ass
programme.desc: A Vietnam veteran who becomes a local hero after saving a man from attackers on a city bus decides to take action when his best friend is murdered and the police show little interest in solving the crime.

programme.title: Bad Ass 2: Bad Asses
programme.desc: Frank Vega (Danny Trejo) teams up with grumpy old agoraphobic Bernie Pope (Danny Glover) to kick ass and clean up the streets of L.A.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A group of friends on their way to the big city are terrorized in an abandoned warehouse where bloodthirsty creatures hunt human prey.

programme.title: Crawl
programme.desc: As a hurricane tears through Florida, Haley rushes to find her father, who is injured and trapped in the crawl space of their home. With the storm intensifying and water levels rising, the pair face an even bigger threat lurking below the surface.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Black Rain
programme.desc: Academy Award-winner Michael Douglas and Andy Garcia play New York cops whose job to escort an assassin back to his native Japan leads the two Americans into Osaka's underworld and straight into the center of a raging battle.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: This confrontation between good and evil stars Kevin Costner as federal agent Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro as gangland kingpin Al Capone, and Sean Connery as Malone, the cop who teaches Ness how to beat the mob: shoot fast and shoot first.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: When a couple of young astronomers discover an enormous comet on course to collide with Earth, the countdown to doomsday begins, and the human race embarks on the fight for survival.

programme.title: Super 8
programme.desc: In the summer of 1979, a group of friends in a small Ohio town witness a catastrophic train crash while making a Super 8 movie and soon suspect that it was not an accident.

programme.title: Arrival
programme.desc: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, an elite team - led by expert translator Louise Banks (Academy Award® nominee Amy Adams) – races against time to decipher their intent.

programme.title: Mario Puzo's The Godfather Coda: The Death of Michael Corleone
programme.desc: Director/screenwriter Francis Ford Coppola's definitive new edit and restoration of THE GODFATHER: PART III, with remastered picture and sound. Michael Corleone (Pacino) seeks to free his family from crime and find a suitable successor to his empire.

programme.title: The Boondock Saints
programme.desc: Two Irish Catholic brothers become vigilantes and wipe out Boston's criminal underworld in the name of God.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: A high-school boy is given the chance to write a story for Rolling Stone Magazine about an up-and-coming rock band as he accompanies it on their concert tour.

programme.title: The Diving Bell And The Butterfly
programme.desc: A remarkable and inspiring true story about the awesome power of imagination starring Mathieu Amalric (QUANTUM OF SOLACE) as renowned editor Jean-Dominique Bauby.

programme.title: Mary Shelley
programme.desc: The torrid true-life tale of how a passionate love affair fueled the creation of trailblazing writer Mary Shelley's Gothic masterwork, Frankenstein. Elle Fanning stars.

programme.title: Sirens
programme.desc: Hugh Grant is a proper Anglican priest who, with his equally prim wife, experiences a libidinous awakening at the country studio of a free-spirited artist.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: A US West Coast teen lifestyle parody centered around Cher, a popular high school girl who spends her days playing match-maker, helping her friends with fashion choices, and looking for a boyfriend.

programme.title: Bobbie Jo And The Outlaw
programme.desc: A stunning carhop who wants to be a country singer and her sweetheart who dreams he's Billy the Kid become involved in robbery and murder.

programme.title: Gone In 60 Seconds
programme.desc: Buckle-up as Eleanor, the fast and furious Ford Fastback Mustang, takes you on a full-throttle ride you'll never forget. The Assignment: To steal 48 muscle and exotic cars! The Challenge: Avoid getting caught!

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: The dangerous world of international heroin trafficking is exposed in this elaborate and suspenseful crime thriller which reprises Sidney Poitier's role as Lt. Virgil Tibbs.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: After a failed global-warming experiment, a post-apocalyptic Ice Age has killed off nearly all life on the planet.

programme.title: Total Recall
programme.desc: It's 2084 A.D. and Doug Quaid is haunted by recurring dreams about journeying to Earths closest planetary neighbor, Mars.

programme.title: Minority Report
programme.desc: In the future, a division of the police department has the technology to arrest killers before they commit crimes; however, the tables turn on one of the cops working within the division.

programme.title: The Italian Job (2003)
programme.desc: The plan was flawless. The execution was perfect. Charlie Croker pulled off the crime of a lifetime. The one thing that he didn't plan on was being double-crossed.

programme.title: Driven
programme.desc: Talented rookie race-car driver Jimmy Bly (Kip Pardue) has started losing his focus and begins to slip in the race rankings. It's no wonder, with the immense pressure being shoveled on him by his overly ambitious promoter brother.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Secret in Their Eyes
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Chiwetel Ejiofor) spends 13 years investigating the brutal murder of a colleague's (Julia Roberts) daughter, then uncovers a new clue that leads to a dark and shocking secret.

programme.title: The Marsh King's Daughter
programme.desc: A young mother must confront her long-buried past as the child of a kidnapper and the girl he held captive when her father breaks out of prison. Convinced he intends to take her daughters, she sets out to find and kill him herself.

programme.title: The Shadow of Violence

programme.title: Una chica en apuros

programme.title: The Descent

programme.desc: Una familia se muda a una casa en Lima buscando comenzar de nuevo. Viven fenómenos extraños y la hija muestra comportamientos raros, buscando ayuda de un sacerdote.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: Una pareja descubre una inquietante presencia en fotografías de un supuesto accidente.

programme.title: Libertador
programme.desc: El aristócrata venezolano del siglo XVIII, Simón Bolívar pelea para liberar a su país y otros territorios sudamericanos del dominio español.

programme.title: Vigilantes de guerra
programme.desc: Jack es un soldado estadounidense que se pone a trabajar en la prisión iraquí de Abu Grhaib. Allí comienza a preocuparse por la forma en que se trata a los presos y se practican las torturas.

programme.title: What Just Happened
programme.desc: Una semana en la vida de Ben, un poderoso productor de Hollywood, mientras hace malabarismos con las negociaciones con un director de estudio para que su última película pueda estrenarse en Cannes en dos semanas.

programme.title: La Hora de la Verdad
programme.desc: El plan de los tres ladrones lo tiene todo para salir adelante -secuestrar al nieto de un millonario y ganar dinero fácil- pero no contaban con el carisma del bebé, lo que enternece el corazón del trío y dificulta la tarea.

programme.title: Rambo 4
programme.desc: El veterano de Vietnam John Rambo ha sobrevivido a muchas pruebas terribles en su vida y desde entonces se ha retirado a una existencia simple y aislada en Tailandia, donde pasa su tiempo capturando serpientes para artistas locales.

programme.title: Una familia peligrosa
programme.desc: Un jefe de la mafia y su familia son trasladados a un pueblo tranquilo en Francia bajo el programa de protección de testigos después de delatar a la mafia.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: Un hombre deprimido conoce a un fabricante de jabones, y juntos forman un club de pelea clandestino que evoluciona en algo inesperado.

programme.title: Un ángel en mi vida
programme.desc: Con la ayuda del Arcángel Gabriel (Dean Cain), Angelina se embarca en una misión casi imposible, tratar de salvar a su malcriada hija de 14 años, Ravin Foxworth, de ir por el camino equivocado.

programme.title: Wish Upon a Star
programme.desc: En este clásico culto, Hayley Wheaton (Danielle Harris) desea cambiar de lugar con su hermana, la mayor y más popular Alexia (Katherine Heigl). Tras una pelea entre las hermanas, ellas despiertan un día a ver que el sueño se ha hecho realidad.

programme.title: Big Time Movie
programme.desc: Los cuatro mejores amigos de Big Time Rush se encuentran rumbo a la primera parada del tour en Londres. En el avión, Carlos tiene un sueño en el cual es un espía y el grupo debe rescatar a una princesa.

programme.title: Un extraño en Sugarcreek
programme.desc: Rachel Troyer es una mujer policía en la pintoresca población de Sugarcreek. Con frecuencia visita a sus tías Amish, que la criaron cuando se quedó huérfana. Cuando un vagabundo aparece con su hijo de cinco años, las bondadosas tías insisten en acogerles.

programme.title: Spotlight on Christmas
programme.desc: Abandonada dos semanas antes de Navidad, la actriz de Hollywood Olivia O'Hara regresa en secreto a su pequeña ciudad natal para evitar a la prensa. Cuando se topa con el profesor de secundaria Casey, él la anima a dirigir la obra navideña de su escuela.

programme.title: Ghosts of Christmas Past
programme.desc: Un adivino le dice a una mujer con un problema de "fantasmas" en serie en aplicaciones de citas que debe resolver su pasado y hacer las paces con todos aquellos a quienes engañó antes de Navidad o estará destinada a nunca encontrar el amor verdadero.

programme.title: Santa Squad, The
programme.desc: Allie, una profesora de arte desempleada, acepta un trabajo para ayudar a un viudo rico y a sus dos hijas. Mientras Allie levanta el espíritu navideño de la familia con adornos navideños, su amabilidad se ve recompensada con un regalo inesperado: ¡Amor!

programme.title: Love in Translation
programme.desc: La estudiante al doctorado en Lingüística Julie puede hablar casi todos los idiomas que puedas imaginar. Las cosas se ponen patas arriba para Julie cuando Dan la contacta para tomar algunas clases de francés. ¿Podría ser esta su pareja perfecta?

programme.title: Quebrando todas las reglas
programme.desc: Una mujer ambiciosa con una educación extraña se esfuerza por encontrarse con dos tipos con los que está saliendo. A pesar de que ambos muchachos se conocen y son completamente opuestos.

programme.title: Una chica en apuros
programme.desc: Surgen complicaciones románticas cuando una estudiante se hace pasar por su hermano gemelo y lo sustituye en su internado.

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: El romance de un hombre con la criada de su familia conduce a oscuras consecuencias. Intensamente erótico y diabólicamente divertido.

programme.title: The Drowning
programme.desc: Tom y Lauren frustran un intento de suicidio por ahogamiento. El joven que se ahoga resulta ser Danny, quien fue acusado del asesinato de una anciana muchos años atrás.

programme.title: Miedo Profundo
programme.desc: Un tranquilo paseo en bote se convierte en una lucha por sobrevivir cuando un grupo de amigos salta al océano para refrescarse pero no puede regresar abordo.

programme.title: Soy el Hijo del Tahúr
programme.desc: El hijo de Tahúr Martín Estrada ha seguido los pasos de su padre se dedica a la apuesta de gallos y caballos de carreras tratando de continuar con el legado de su padre.

programme.title: Te Presumo
programme.desc: Esta es la historia de un empresario que tiene la vida ideal. Un día cuando regresa de una carrera de motos en la que su hijo gano el primer lugar todo da un vuelco en sus vidas.

programme.title: Terror en la Sangre
programme.desc: Unas amigas que van a una fiesta que no existe y reciben un invitado sobrenatural. Un hombre camina en un estacionamiento solitario sin saber que va a encontrar algo aterrador. Dos chicas invocan a su amiga fallecida. Historias de terror de Guadalajara.

programme.title: Retorno A La Juventud
programme.desc: Juan Gaudio un hombre maduro y con profesor de psicología está profundamente enamorado de la joven Inés, quien se burla de él diciéndole que lo amaría si fuera joven.

programme.title: Sinfonía De Una Vida

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan entra en pánico cuando la directora de la escuela pide una reunión con él y sus padres. Pensando que hizo algo malo, decide contratar a dos actores para que hagan de sus padres durante la cita.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel deciden saltarse un día de escuela y trabajo. Se hacen pasar por enfermos, pero pronto se encuentran en grandes problemas, cuando son atrapados en un robo de banco y terminan apareciendo en las noticias.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel están en el trabajo cuando un payaso de circo entra en Rigby’s y roba la tienda. Las cosas empeoran cuando el mismo payaso aparece más tarde en la fiesta de cumpleaños de Kyra, y los muchachos deciden entrar en acción.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kel gana 64 millones de dólares en la lotería y quiere dividir el premio con su mejor amigo, Kenan. Parece que las cosas están saliendo bastante bien para ambos, hasta que Kel pierde el billete ganador.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan le apuesta a Kel que no puede estar una semana sin beber gaseosa de naranja, por lo que Kenan hará cualquier artimaña para que Kel pierda.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Está en el nivel tres cuando Yugi y sus amigos son transportados a un páramo cubierto de lava. Para empeorar las cosas, Joey está poseído por una fuerza maligna, y destruirlo también puede significar destruir a Joey.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos se enfrentan a una tarea imposible: localizar una manzana mágica en un bosque lleno de manzanos.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi y sus amigos derrotan a los Cinco demonios ... o eso creen. ¡Estos dragones feroces se han fusionado y ahora son más poderosos que nunca!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Los amigos de Yugi están inconscientes, dejándolo derrotar a Alejandro Magno solo!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: La historia vuelve a hacer un alto en el camino para narrarnos la situación de algunos de los integrantes de los Sombrero de Paja. En este caso veremos lo que están haciendo Nami en Weatheria y Franky en Baldimore.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: En este episodio veremos cómo están saliendo adelante otros dos miembros de los Sombrero de Paja.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Por un lado veremos la situación de Robin en Tequila Wolf después de que la hayan apresado y por otro lado la historia sigue en las Islas Bowin, donde se puede a ver a Usopp con serios problemas con la comida.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Zoro sigue en aquel alejado castillo con la única compañía de Perona, quien se está hartando de su pésimo sentido de la orientación.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Ahora que Luffy está realmente cerca de Marineford, recuerda las diferentes situaciones que han llevado a Ace y a Luffy a estar donde están ahora. Se rememora parte de su infancia, el encuentro en Alabasta o la pelea que tuvo Ace contra Barbanegra.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Mientras Luffy sigue de camino hacia Marineford, vemos un poco las relaciones que han ido teniendo con los Sombrero de Paja todos los principales participantes de la gran guerra que se avecina: los Ouka Shichibukai y los almirantes de la Marina.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Se acerca la temida hora de la verdad. Mientras Ace está en la plataforma de ejecución, aparece el almirante de flota Sengoku para revelar al mundo entero una impactante verdad y que explica por qué querían acabar con Ace.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: La gente sigue sin dar crédito a lo que acaba de oír respecto al pasado de Ace. Aprovechando la confusión empiezan a llegar numerosos barcos llenos de piratas, aunque no parece que Barbablanca esté a bordo de ninguno de ellos.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Barbablanca y los suyos aparecen en Marineford saliendo del agua y con la clara intención de llevarse a Ace sano y salvo. Pero antes de eso veremos el pasado de Ace y Barbablanca para entender mejor el vínculo que hay entre ambos.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Se acabaron las presentaciones, comienza la gran guerra entre los Piratas Barbablanca y el cuartel general de la Marina. Parece que Mihawk, quien generalmente no participa en estas situaciones, está dispuesto a tomar parte en el combate.

programme.title: El Fantástico Jaspion

programme.title: El Fantástico Jaspion
programme.desc: La última batalla comienza donde Jaspion y Edin se enfrentan a Satan Goss y Kilmaza.

programme.title: Black Kamen Rider

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: La Abeja Maya

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Una Misión Peligrosa! Un Viaje A La Tierra De Las Olas
programme.desc: Naruto y sus compañeros comienzan sus primeras misiones ninja. Son tareas aburridas, enojadas y frustradas, y Naruto se alivia diciéndole todo al Hokage. Entretenido por el entusiasmo de Naruto, les asigna una nueva misión: proteger al viejo Tazuna.

programme.title: Naruto: El Asesino De La Neblina
programme.desc: Naruto y su grupo llegan a Tierra de las Olas,donde un malvado hombre llamado Gato se apodero del lugar. Allí aparece Zabuza, contratado por Gato para matar a Tazuna. Naruto está deseando enfrentarse a este asesino ninja. ¿Estará listo para este desafío?

programme.title: Naruto: El Juramento Del Dolor
programme.desc: Kakashi se pone delante durante la batalla contra Zabuza. Pero ¡todo cambia cuando Kakashi es atrapado en la Prisión de Agua de Zabuza! Kakashi pide que huyan, pero Naruto recuerda la promesa que hizo -no volver a huir nunca más- y se mantiene firme!

programme.title: Naruto: Kakashi: Guerrero Sharingan
programme.desc: Gracias al plan de Naruto, Kakashi se libera de la Prisión de Agua y derrota a Zabuza. Un misterioso ninja aparece de repente y acaba con Zabuza antes de que Kakashi lo haga. Naruto se sorprende al ver que un muchacho ha podido derrotar a Zabuza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Bosque Del Chakra
programme.desc: Kakashi no está satisfecho con el resultado de la batalla, cree que Zabuza no ha muerto. Kakashi decide poner en marcha un interesante entrenamiento que permitirá a Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura controlar mejor su chakra.

programme.title: Naruto: El País Donde Existió un Héroe
programme.desc: Sakura y Tazuna van a la aldea, y ven sufrimiento de habitantes de la Tierras a causa de Gato, por eso Tazuna arriesga su vida. Con un puente, los habitantes no dependerían de Gato, quien controla todos los negocios. Naruto y Sasuke continúan entrenando.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡Batalla En El Puente! ¡Zabuza Regresa!
programme.desc: Mientras Naruto se concentra en el entrenamiento, una misteriosa figura aparece y le dice que si alguien tiene el deseo de proteger lo que ama, puede llegar a ser tan fuerte como quiera.

programme.title: Naruto: El Jutsu Secreto De Haku, Los Espejos Cristal De Hielo
programme.desc: Llega el momento de enfrentarse a Zabuza pero en esta ocasión tiene compañía: el ninja rastreador. Él y su compañero se fijan en las habilidades de Sasuke, y los dos se da cuenta del poder que oculta el ninja enmascarado. La batalla comienza.

programme.title: Naruto: El Número Uno Hiperactivo Ninja Cabeza Hueca Entra A Jugar
programme.desc: Sasuke se encuentra en un apuro, pero Naruto acude al rescate. Sasuke tiene un plan para oponerse al jutsu de Haku. Naruto arruina la estrategia de Sasuke y los dos jóvenes ninjas son atrapados.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan le apuesta a Kel que no puede estar una semana sin beber gaseosa de naranja, por lo que Kenan hará cualquier artimaña para que Kel pierda.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Cuando el jugador estrella de baloncesto, Harper Ron,se lesiona la rodilla al resbalarse en un charco de gaseosa de naranja en Rigby’s, Kenan y Kel son culpados y se convierten en las personas más odiadas de la ciudad de Chicago.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Rigby's ha sido elegida como el set de la nueva película "Policía de Supermercado 3", y Kenan y Kel se ofrecen como extras. Todo lo que tienen que hacer es seguir las instrucciones del director, pero terminan arruinando todo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Después de que Kel le causara serias heridas en la espalda a Roger, este le prohibió la entrada a la casa de los Rockmore. Como resultado de ello, Kel trata de convencer a Roger que le permita volver a entrar.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Roger obtiene un nuevo trabajo que requiere mudarse a Pummis, Montana, teniendo que llevarse a toda la familia con él. Kel prepara un regalo de despedida para Kenan, pero cuando llega a la casa de los Rockmore, no hay nadie.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Roger obtiene un nuevo trabajo que requiere mudarse a Pummis, Montana, teniendo que llevarse a toda la familia con él. Kel prepara un regalo de despedida para Kenan, pero cuando llega a la casa de los Rockmore, no hay nadie.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan y Kel conocen a dos chicas y las invitan a salir al cine. Kel compra un yo-yo para regalarlo, pero se le cae tras una reja. Kenan intenta recuperarlo, pero su cabeza queda atrapada y no puede moverse de allí.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Kenan tiene un nuevo vecino llamado Marc Cram, un coleccionista de relojes. Cuando Kenan piensa que Marc le robó su reloj, elabora un plan para atrapar a Marc y probar que es un ladrón.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Los Rockmore compran un televisor ultra moderno. Mientras tanto, Chris hace una rifa en Rigby's para sortear un televisor, pero Kel, accidentalmente, se sube encima y lo destroza.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡El pasado se está volviendo rápidamente peligroso cuando el intrépido rey bandido Bakura ha invadido el palacio del faraón para derrotar a los guardianes de los siete Artículos del Milenio sin ayuda!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Incluso con el potente poder de Obelisk the Tormentor, el Faraón no pudo evitar que el bandido Bakura escapara. Todos saben que el ladrón volverá para una revancha, por lo que Seto tiene un plan para crear un ejército poderoso.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mahad promete detener los ataques furtivos del rey bandido Bakura de una vez por todas, ¡pero puede haber hecho una promesa que no puede cumplir!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mahad, el primero de los guardianes del faraón, ha caído. Peor aún, el rey bandido Bakura ahora tiene el Anillo del Milenio, lo que hace que su Diabound sea aún más imparable.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Se revelan los orígenes de los Artículos del Milenio! ¿Quién falsificó estos poderosos artefactos y por qué fueron creados? Aunque los Artículos del Milenio son poderosos, dicho poder tiene un precio muy alto ... ¡una deuda que nunca podrá pagarse!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El faraón convoca al poderoso dios egipcio Slifer, el dragón del cielo, para luchar contra el Diabound del bandido Bakura, pero cuando Diabound comienza a atacar a la gente del pueblo, ¡el faraón debe protegerlos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: El bandido Bakura ha robado el Rompecabezas del Milenio y ha enviado al faraón al precipicio. ¡Ahora está un paso más cerca de obtener los siete Objetos del Milenio y resucitar al malévolo Zorc, el mal más grande de todos los tiempos!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Yugi y el Faraón se reencuentran, pero el Faraón no tiene poder sin el Rompecabezas del Milenio! Sin embargo, eso no detendrá al Faraón de un enfrentamiento final contra el bandido rey Bakura.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: ¡Es el enfrentamiento en la arena entre el bandido Bakura y su Diabound versus el faraón, Mahad the Dark Magician y los guardianes restantes del faraón!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Con la ayuda del espíritu de su padre, el Faraón y sus guardianes derrotaron al Diaband del bandido Bakura y evitaron que el horrible Zorc resucitara ... ¿o sí?

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: League of Legends es un exponente independiente que cambio el mundo del entretenimiento digital al formalizar y popularizar el fenomeno de los esports. Hoy es momento de revisar su historia.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: La sensacion de euforia despues de sobrepasar un gran reto es un sentimiento que muchos esperan de sus juegos favoritos, hasta el grado de que algunos se han vuelto adictos.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: De la mano de Bungie, creadores de Halo, llego una nueva franquicia que mezclaria elementos miticos y legendarios en un formato de mundo compartido resultando en un producto diferente pero exitoso

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la novedosa transición generacional del bombardero azul de Capcom. Esta es la historia de Mega Man X.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Los videojuegos basados en series animadas han sido parte integral del éxito de la industria. Hoy veremos su historia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia de Rare y el juego que causo los celos de Shigeru Miyamoto

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Repasamos la historia del RPG de accion por excelencia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hoy hablaremos del juego de plataformas 2D por excelencia y su impresionante salto entre los 8 y 16 bits. Esta es la historia detras de Super Mario World

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos sobre la arriesgada apuesta de Gearbox Software que dio origen al genero Loot Shooter como lo conocemos. Esta es la historia de Borderlands.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la histroia de Super Metroid, un titulo de calibre legendario que estuvo 3 veces en el borde de la cancelacion.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia detras de Final Fantasy VII, el juego de Square que popularizo los RPG en todo el mundo. Final Fantasy VII llevo al genero y a los videojuegos mas alla de sus limites.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: En los 90, nadie hubiera imaginado que Nintendo estuviera al frente del genero de peleas con el titulo con mayor presencia y mejores ventas en la industria de los videojuegos

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la historia del videojuego que puso a Polonia en el ojo de la industria, y cuyo climax, nos entrego uno de los titulos RPG mas celebrados y condecorados de la octava generacion de consolas

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Monster Hunter se convirtió en una de las franquicias más reconocidas de Capcom a lo largo de su historia. Desde su debut en 2004, se ha colado a las listas de lo más vendido de la compañía japonesa

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Bully, desarrollado por Rockstar Vancouver (antes Barking Dog Studios), es una de las entregas más peculiares de Rockstar Games por alejarse de los hampones y la vida del crímen.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hace muchos anos las mascotas de videojuegos que dominaban el mercado eran 2: Mario de Nintendo y Sonic de SEGA. Esto cambio con Crash Bandicoot en PlayStation. En seguida, te contamos su historia.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar el clasico hit de 2005 desarrollado por SCE Santa Monica Studio para PlayStation 2: God of War.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de contarte sobre la creacion del grupo de asesinos que juraron proteger al mundo de La Orden de los Templarios. Nada es verdad, todo esta permitido. Esta es la historia detras de: Assassin's Creed.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Rare; unico, singular. Extraordinario. Dice la leyenda que su nivel era tan alto, que llego a poner celoso a mas de uno, incluso al mismisimo Shigueru Miyamoto. Por esto, es momento de ver la historia detras de Banjo Kazooie.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Es momento de revisar la historia de desarrollo de The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuáles son las claves que han hecho a Nintendo la compañía emblemática que es? En este episodio de Cybernet analizamos a fondo la filosofía que ha ayudado a Nintendo a diferenciarse de sus competidoras.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Se acabaron las presentaciones, comienza la gran guerra entre los Piratas Barbablanca y el cuartel general de la Marina. Parece que Mihawk, quien generalmente no participa en estas situaciones, está dispuesto a tomar parte en el combate.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Los Piratas Barbablanca comienzan el asedio a Marineford y se topan con la resistencia que ofrecen los tres almirantes de la Marina. Debido a ello, por fin se ve en acción a Akainu, del que se desconocían sus poderes.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Little Oars Jr. es el descendiente de Oars, a quien Luffy y compañía tuvieron que hacer frente en Thriller Bark. Este grandulón está en la tripulación de los Piratas Barbablanca y va corriendo hacia la plataforma de ejecución para salvar a su amigo Ace.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga
programme.desc: Barbablanca y todos sus compañeros sufren mucho tras la muerte de Little Oars Jr. y siguen adelante con el asedio a Marineford. Por otro lado, hay alguien más que está sufriendo particularmente por esta situación: Garp.

programme.title: One Piece - Summit War Saga

programme.desc: Palabritas nos presentan un paraguas; cuatro ratoncitos viajan alrededor del mundo en Viajando por el Mundo con los números; y aprendan a contar hasta dos en Los Números De La Granja.

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Únanse a Viajando por el Mundo con los números y conozcan a tres monos; las ardillas de Esconder y Buscar esconden la bellota en el dormitorio; y mucho más.

programme.title: Lo Mejor de BabyFirst
programme.desc: La pandilla BabyFirst ha vuelto a inspirar a su pequeño. Aprenda sobre un jugador de Baseball con Harry y Larry, explore un banjo con GooGoo y GaaGaa y mucho más!

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Disfrute este bloque donde su pequeño será presentado a uvas, manzanas, conejos, pájaros y mucho más.

programme.title: Clase de bebé: Vocabulario y números
programme.desc: Cuenten autos con Widget; ayuden a los amigos ardilla Sammy y Eva a encontrar la bellota en el cuarto de juegos: y aprendan todo sobre la palabra “Avión”.

programme.title: Dulces sueños: Canciones, música y arte
programme.desc: Viaja tranquilo con este bloque nocturno con imagenes submarinas de los Puntos de Buceo, dibujos de arena y más.

programme.title: Dulces sueños: Canciones, música y arte
programme.desc: Este bloque nocturno calmará a su hijo mientras ve carruseles animados y las hermosas vistas de los animales.

programme.title: Naruto: El Número Uno Hiperactivo Ninja Cabeza Hueca Entra A Jugar
programme.desc: Sasuke se encuentra en un apuro, pero Naruto acude al rescate. Sasuke tiene un plan para oponerse al jutsu de Haku. Naruto arruina la estrategia de Sasuke y los dos jóvenes ninjas son atrapados.

programme.title: Naruto: Visibilidad Cero: El Sharingan Desquebrajado
programme.desc: Kakashi se da cuenta de que el tiempo apremia y decide usar el Sharingan para derrotar a Zabuza. Pero Zabuza ha preparado una estrategia contra él.

programme.title: Naruto: El Sello Roto
programme.desc: Naruto y Sasuke reciben los ataques de los espejos de hielo de cristal de Haku. Naruto no se para, Sasuke se da cuenta del poder de su propio Sharingan y comienza a evitar ataques. Haku toma a Sasuke por sorpresa, quien protege a Naruto.

programme.title: Naruto: Pasado Blanco: Ambición Escondida
programme.desc: Naruto estalla su ira contra Haku, quien derrotó a Sasuke, desata el poder del Zorro de las Nueve Colas. El chakra de Naruto es tan intenso que incluso alerta a Kakashi y Zabuza, Haku está indefenso ante el poder oculto de Naruto.

programme.title: Naruto: Las Armas Conocidas Como Shinobi
programme.desc: Haku le pide a Naruto que lo termine. Naruto cuestiona a Haku y su existencia solo para luchar y ganar. Kakashi y Zabuza alcanzan el clímax y Kakashi retiene el movimiento de Zabuza. Con la victoria a su alcance, lanza su devastador ataque.

programme.title: Naruto: El Demonio De La Nieve
programme.desc: Naruto enfrenta a Zabuza. Aunque parece no tener emociones, Zabuza está desolado por la pérdida de Haku, la única persona del mundo en la que podía confiar. Naruto se da cuenta de que esta cruel realidad es el destino de los ninjas.

programme.title: Naruto: Un Nuevo Capítulo Comienza: El Examen Chunin
programme.desc: Naruto y compañia regresan a la Aldea Escondida entre las Hojas después de su batalla en la Tierra de las Olas. Aunque cumplen las misiones, Naruto no está satisfecho. Pronto descubre que los extraños están apareciendo en el Leaf Village.

programme.title: Naruto: Identifíquense: Nuevos Y Poderosos Rivales
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura son de los elegidos para tomar el Examen Chunin, pero Iruka se opone a que participen. Son muy jóvenes y carecen de la experiencia y habilidades necesarias. Kakashi piensa que están listos para afrontar el desafío.

programme.title: Naruto: Reto Chunin: Rock Lee Versus Sasuke
programme.desc: Mientras se preparan para el examen, Rock Lee entra en escena. Lee quiere enfrentarse a Sasuke, quien guarda el poder del Clan Uchiha. Sasuke acepta el reto pero los ataques de su oponente son tan rápidos que lo único que puede hacer es defenderse.

programme.title: Naruto: ¡La Batalla Genin! Los Nueve Novatos Se Enfrentan
programme.desc: Naruto, Sasuke y Sakura se inscriben al Examen Chunin, en el tres ninjas deben formar equipo y ninguno puede fallar. El trabajo en equipo es indispensable. Se quedan estupefactos al ver que hay muchos otros que persiguen el mismo sueño.
